description: This Dart file implements a Flutter widget 'DocumentViewScreen' for viewing a document with inline preview options such as image rendering or text display, along with actions like share, edit, delete, and open externally. It manages state asynchronously, interacts with various services and repositories, and supports user interactions.

classes.name: DocumentViewScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that displays a single document with inline preview, actions such as share, edit, delete, and open externally. It loads document data asynchronously, determines content type (image or text), and provides interaction handlers.

classes.name: _HeaderMeta
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays document metadata including icon, name, and notes or mime type.

classes.name: _GenericPreview
classes.description: A widget showing a generic file representation with options to share or open externally.

classes.name: _ActionBar
classes.description: A widget providing action buttons for sharing, editing, deleting, and opening externally, with configurable visibility.

classes.name: _PreviewError
classes.description: A simple widget to display an error message when previewing content fails.

classes.name: _NotFoundBody
classes.description: A widget indicating that the requested document was not found.

methods.name: _loadDocument
methods.description: Loads document data from repository, determines content type for preview, reads text if applicable, and updates state.

methods.name: _share
methods.description: Initiates sharing the document file and name via the ShareService.

methods.name: _delete
methods.description: Handles document deletion with user confirmation, deletes file, updates repository, and navigates back.

methods.name: _edit
methods.description: Opens a dialog to edit document name and tags, updates repository, and reloads data.

methods.name: _promptEdit
methods.description: Displays a dialog allowing user to input new name and notes/tags for the document.

methods.name: _openExternal
methods.description: Attempts to open the file externally using the default app via 'OpenFilex'.

methods.name: _buildPreviewArea
methods.description: Builds the preview widget based on whether the document is an image, text, or fallback.

methods.name: _pickIcon
methods.description: Selects an icon based on the mime type for display in the header.
